Prove that $Z(f)$ is closed.", "assumptions": [], "domain": "real_analysis", "explicit_subgoals": [], "candidate_text": "Since \(f:X\to\mathbb R\) is continuous and \(\{0\}\) is closed in \(\mathbb R\), the inverse image \(f^{-1}(\{0\})\) is closed in \(X\). By definition,
\[
f^{-1}(\{0\})=\{p\in X:f(p)=0\}=Z(f).
\]
Therefore \(Z(f)\) is closed."}
